sources.entry: f.lux - Makes the color of your computer's display adapt to the time of day. ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: f.lux
summary.one_liner: f.lux is software that adjusts a computer display's color temperature to be warm at night and like sunlight during the day.
use_cases: sleep better when using a computer at night
reduce eye strain from bright screens at night
automatically adjust screen color through the day
summary.what_it_does: f.lux changes the color of a computer display based on the time of day, warming the screen at night and returning it to sunlight-like tones during the day. The user sets their lighting type and location, and the software then adjusts automatically. The goal is to make the screen look like the room the user is in. The page presents it as a way to help with sleep and to make the display look better. The page also mentions a patent-pending status and a separate FAQ for IT administrators using it at work.
notable: Automatically adapts display color to time of day and location after initial setup
Matches screen color to indoor lighting type
Listed in awesome-mac under Quality of Life Improvements as freeware
Patent pending according to the page
caveats: Page asks for voluntary donations (PayPal) but does not state pricing terms
Platforms are not named on the page text provided, though the awesome-mac listing suggests macOS
